name: google-client-import
accessibilityTree:
- main:
  - paragraph: Campus Commander
  - heading "Configure Google sign-in" [level=1]
  - heading "Create the Google client" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - text: Open
      - link "Google Auth branding":
        - /url: https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/branding
      - text: for your test project.
    - listitem: Select an Internal audience for your Google Workspace organization.
    - listitem:
      - text: Create a
      - link "Web application client":
        - /url: https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients
      - text: .
    - listitem:
      - text: "Add this exact redirect URI:"
      - code: https://127.0.0.1:37615/api/auth/callback
      - button "Copy redirect URI"
    - listitem: Download the client JSON.
  - paragraph: This configures application sign-in. It does not grant access to Gmail, Drive, or user administration.
  - text: Google Web application client JSON
  - button "Google Web application client JSON"
  - button "Import Google client"
  - status: Connected. Create and import your Google client.
  - alert
